items.quote: And Moses spake before the LORD, saying, Behold, the children of Israel have not hearkened unto me; how then shall Pharaoh hear me, who am of uncircumcised lips?
items.claim: Moses expressed doubt that Pharaoh would listen to him because he had a speech impediment

items.quote: Behold, the children of Israel have not hearkened unto me
items.claim: The children of Israel did not listen to Moses

items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel, and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.
items.claim: The LORD commanded Moses and Aaron to lead the children of Israel out of Egypt
